snippet.title: Penguin Lifter | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Penguin Lifter is a game where you work as a penguin lifter. A job in the fresh air, far from civilization, surrounded by adorable creatures — penguins. Here, it's just you, the snow, and the penguins...

On July 13, the game Penguin Lifter will be available on Steam!

Add to Wishlist so you don't miss it.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4836650/Penguin_Lifter/
